images.screen: A · 장터 — 쪽지가 사람 손을 거치며 말이 바뀐다
images.prompt: Actual in-game screenshot of a 2D Korean Joseon-era deckbuilding strategy game, 16:9 landscape, full-bleed, no device frame, no poster framing, no title card. Top-down hand-painted ink-wash (sumukhwa) map of a small riverside market village at dusk on aged brown hanji paper: two dirt roads drawn with dry brush strokes run left to right, crossing a blue-grey stream, and both end at a red-roofed merchant hall with a wooden signboard reading "宋氏商團". Along the roads stand seven villager portraits in round ink-circle medallions with small Korean name labels: "박 노인", "뱃사공", "주모", "훈장", "엿장수", "객주 하인", "포졸". A small folded paper note is mid-travel along the upper road beside "주모", and a dark tooltip next to it shows a brush-script Korean sentence with one phrase struck through in red and the replacement highlighted in gold: "김 객주네 맏아들이 ~~노름빚을 졌다더라~~ 집문서를 걸었다더라" with a small line "위력 2→3 · 거짓 2→3". Bottom of the screen: a fanned hand of five cream hanji paper cards with fibrous texture and red square seal cost stamps (1, 1, 1, 2, 1); each card shows a hand-brushed Korean rumor sentence such as "송씨 상단 소금에 모래가 섞였다더라" and small red power pips. Right side: three slim gauges labelled "송씨 상단 신용 26", "우리 상단 평판 16", "장터에 쌓인 거짓 5 / 10" with a red threshold tick marked "역풍", and below them a ledger log of short Korean lines. Top-left title in brush calligraphy "소문은 덱이다" and "장날 2 / 8", three brass yeopjeon coins as energy. Warm lantern light, muted ochre, ink black, seal red palette, crisp UI, subtle paper grain.

images.screen: B · 한 장의 족보 — 같은 쪽지가 다섯 번 돌고 온 모습
images.prompt: Actual in-game screenshot of a 2D Korean Joseon-era deckbuilding game's card-history screen, 16:9 landscape, full-bleed, no device frame, no poster framing. Dark brown lacquered wooden desk background lit by a single oil lamp. In the center, a vertical lineage of six overlapping cream hanji paper slips pinned with tiny wooden pegs, each a later version of the same rumor card, connected by dotted gold lines labelled with the villagers it passed through ("뱃사공 · 과장", "주모 · 과장", "박 노인 · 와전", "포졸 · 꼬리"). The slips show hand-brushed Korean sentences growing more extreme from top to bottom, with old words struck through in red ink and new words underlined: top "송씨 상단 저울이 조금 기운다더라", middle "송씨 상단 저울로 과부 쌀을 떼먹었다더라", bottom "김 객주네 저울 때문에 사람이 목을 맸다더라" where the target name is stamped over in blue ink. Lower slips carry small red cloth ribbons tied to their corners (marking a traced source) and a blue stamp "와전". On the left, a small handwritten table of villager temperaments; on the right, a simple bar chart in ochre, jade and gold drawn like ink on paper with label "정책별 승률". Muted ochre, ink black, seal red, indigo palette, warm vignette, readable Korean typography, subtle paper fibers.
